core: MECP2 control of neuronal gene expression
qualifier: with calcium channel and translation repression
name: MECP2 regulation of neuronal genes, channels and translation
rationale: Members are MECP2 regulatory targets, Rett-type MECP2 loss-of-function events and MECP2-annotated neuronal processes; unlike the MECP2 confusables it carries calcium-channel and cytoplasmic-translation repression rather than NCoR/HDAC corepressor or behavioural terms.

qualifier: NRF2 transcriptional program, NADPH supply and ferroptosis
name: NRF2-driven redox defense, NADPH supply and ferroptosis
rationale: Members cover NFE2L2 target programs, NADPH/isocitrate supply, ROS detoxification and ferroptosis control; the NFE2L2 regulation distinguishes it from glutathione, p53-metabolic and HIF/hypoxia confusables.

name: Physiological nucleoside and nucleobase membrane transport
rationale: All members are plasma-membrane transport of nucleosides (adenosine, uridine) and purine bases; the closest confusable adds antiviral drug handling (abacavir, ribavirin) that this theme lacks.

name: ER tubular network shaping, fusion and positioning
rationale: Members concern ER tubule formation, membrane bending, ER fusion, tethering and localization, distinguishing it from confusables centred on ER lipid transfer and Golgi traffic.

Half the members are male germline (Y-linked, spermatogonial division, germline stem cell maintenance) and half are generic nuclear gene expression steps (lncRNA transcription, mRNA export, crotonylation) with no shared biological theme.

qualifier: activating regulation, granzyme killing and MHC-Ib recognition
name: NK cell cytotoxic activation, granzyme killing and MHC-Ib recognition
rationale: Members are NK cytotoxicity, degranulation and NK signatures with positive regulation, granzyme death and MHC class Ib presentation, unlike confusables carrying KIR, inhibitory regulation and tolerance or T cell activation.

name: Cobalamin uptake, transport, metabolism and inherited deficiency disorders
rationale: All members concern vitamin B12 absorption, transport, intracellular processing and their genetic defects, distinguishing it from thiamin/riboflavin and folate-methionine confusables.

name: CSF1 receptor signaling and macrophage proliferation
rationale: Members are M-CSF/CSF1R signaling (including interleukin SHC routes) and macrophage proliferation, distinct from G-CSF, osteoclast and IL-6 confusables.

name: Prostanoid G protein-coupled receptor signaling
rationale: Members are prostanoid receptors, prostaglandin D response and GPCR gene clusters, distinct from confusables covering prostaglandin synthesis and leukotrienes.

name: Nucleoside monophosphate turnover, including pyrimidine salvage
rationale: Members are (deoxy)nucleoside monophosphate metabolism and catabolism; CMP metabolism and UMP salvage separate it from purine deoxynucleoside and pyrimidine base catabolism confusables.

name: CSF1-driven mononuclear phagocyte differentiation and osteoclast fusion
rationale: Members combine M-CSF signaling with monocyte, macrophage, dendritic cell and osteoclast differentiation, proliferation and fusion; the differentiation and fusion terms separate it from CSF1 signaling and bone-remodeling confusables.

core: LXR control of lipid metabolism genes
name: LXR control of lipogenesis, lipolysis and VLDL remodeling
rationale: Members are NR1H2/NR1H3 (LXR) target programs for lipogenesis and adipose lipolysis plus VLDL remodeling, unlike confusables on PKA/AMPK triglyceride control, lipophagy or lipoprotein clearance.

qualifier: Pol I/III transcription with rRNA, snRNA and splicing
name: Nuclear RNA synthesis and maturation, including Pol I/III transcription
rationale: Members span Pol I/II/III transcription, rRNA/snRNA/tRNA processing, splicing and nuclear RNA decay with MYC targets; the Pol I/III and rRNA terms separate it from mRNA export/NMD, Pol II initiation and telomerase confusables.

name: Cadherin adherens junction dynamics, including endothelial morphogenesis
rationale: Members concern cadherin-mediated adherens junction assembly and its positive and negative regulation, with endothelial morphogenesis and TGF-beta EMT distinguishing it from epithelial-polarity and CDH1-trafficking confusables.

qualifier: dendritic cell and monocyte trafficking and differentiation
name: Chemokine-directed dendritic cell and monocyte migration and differentiation
rationale: Members combine CCR1/CCR7 chemokine signaling, DC and NK chemotaxis, DC maturation and monocyte differentiation, unlike confusables focused on lymphocyte homing or monocyte surface activation.

name: Microglial activation and amyloid-beta clearance in neurodegeneration
rationale: Members cover microglial activation, proliferation and migration alongside amyloid-beta formation, fibrillization and clearance and tangle assembly, combining what the glial-only and amyloid-only confusables separate.

qualifier: TGFBR3 co-receptor, activin branch and cancer mutants
name: TGF-beta/activin receptor signaling, TGFBR3 co-receptor and cancer mutants
rationale: Members are TGF-beta, activin and AMH receptor signaling with TGFBR3 regulation and cancer-associated receptor/SMAD mutants, distinguishing it from SMAD-downregulation, RUNX3/Hippo and MET confusables.

qualifier: retinol and retinal transport and metabolism
name: Retinol and retinaldehyde metabolism and transport
rationale: Members are retinol and retinal metabolic processes (diterpenoid/hydrocarbon terms included), distinct from visual-cycle disease and retinoic acid confusables.

name: Purine nucleoside transport, including antiviral nucleoside analogue uptake
rationale: Members are nucleoside/purine base membrane transport plus abacavir and ribavirin transport and handling, which separates it from physiological nucleoside transport and thiopurine/NUDT confusables.

name: Chromatin coregulator transcription control via HDAC corepressors and SUMOylation
rationale: Members are coregulator complexes acting on transcription (HDAC, NuRD, NCoR/SMRT, E2F6, CHD6-9, arginine methylation, SUMOylated cofactors), narrower than BAF/PRC2/histone-methylation confusables and lacking retroelement silencing.

name: Formyl peptide receptor-driven leukocyte chemotaxis and chemokine production
rationale: Members are FPR-mediated neutrophil and macrophage recruitment with CCL2/CCL3/CCL5 production, the chemokine-production terms separating it from neutrophil-migration confusables.

name: Mitotic chromosome condensation, cohesion, spindle and cytokinesis
rationale: Members cover chromosome condensation, sister chromatid cohesion, centromere assembly, spindle, cytokinesis and nuclear envelope reformation, distinct from APC/C, centrosome, NE disassembly and meiotic recombination confusables.

name: Presynaptic calcium-dependent modulation of GABA and glutamate release
rationale: Members are presynaptic calcium and vesicle exocytosis control of GABAergic and glutamatergic transmission, unlike confusables centred on G-protein channel inhibition or inhibitory synapse assembly.

name: BMP/Nodal ligand regulation in endothelial specification and vascular morphogenesis
rationale: Members combine extracellular BMP/Nodal sequestration and signaling with endothelial fate and vessel morphogenesis, distinct from TGF-beta, cardiac vascular and adherens junction confusables.

qualifier: MYC-driven, RNA polymerase I rRNA transcription
name: MYC-driven ribosome biogenesis and RNA polymerase I rRNA transcription
rationale: Members are MYC target programs, Pol I rRNA transcription, nucleolar chromatin and ribosome assembly, without the Pol III, splicing, Pol II or translation-initiation content of confusables.
